_help: Upcoming events. date = YYYY-MM-DD in JST; time = HH:MM JST (optional). type = unlock|macro|listing|upgrade|exchange|other. tokens = affected symbols ([] = whole market). impact = high|medium|low. Each text has a th version. Remove past events after ~7 days.
